$Comment: What the Greater Disenchanting Table pays over the lesser one, essence half: a same-id copy of RPG Stations' own Disenchant_Greater_Bonus (the jar's Disenchant_Greater action already lists it, so no extension names it), carrying the jar's Life essence ladder unchanged (item level at 1, quality at 5: 1 more for any piece, 2 more from about a cobalt piece up, 3 more from a mithril piece up; a jar retune of it means copying it here again). The jar's second roll, the greater table's extra Void essence chance, lives in Mmo_Disenchant_Greater_Void instead, so Kit Rite can shut it there without touching this essence.
